name: Kiton
why: Hand-made Neapolitan tailoring from a company with its own tailoring school and wool mill.
origin: Founded in Arzano, near Naples, in 1968 by Ciro Paone.

onething.n: verified — direct product on us.kiton.com; if the SKU sells out, fall back to /collections/men

notes.craft: Kiton's own site describes owned making across the range: the Arzano tailoring origin, an outerwear company in Parma, a knitwear factory in Fidenza, a wool mill in Biella (Lanificio Kiton Carlo Barbera), and PDPs that name its own Fidenza, Collecchio and Marcianise factories. Its tailoring school operates in the house's own workshops. Owned making covers tailoring, knitwear, outerwear, trousers and cloth, so the 5 holds, though tailoring PDPs do not name the factory.
notes.wool: owns Lanificio Carlo Barbera, weaving its cloth in Biella since 2010
notes.ital: Naples as the product — the fabric, the school, the hands
notes.boat: The deck of something you are driven to rather than something you drive. Neapolitan tailoring in the softest possible cloth, for a boat with a crew on it.
notes.racquet: The softest possible version of club dress, which places it at the tailoring end of the register rather than anywhere near a court.

craft_evidence.owned_d: Kiton's own site names a network of owned making across categories. Kitonism page: founded 1968 in a small workshop in Arzano (outskirts of Naples) that 'had grown into an 36,000-square-foot factory'; later acquisitions of 'a historic company in Parma specializing in outerwear, a knitwear factory in Fidenza, and a woolen mill in Biella'. Fabrics page: 'Lanificio Kiton Carlo Barbera produces the maison's exclusive wool fabrics'. PDPs: knitwear 'crafted in our Fidenza factory' (22 steps, half by hand); sportswear outerwear 'created in our Collecchio factory'; trousers/jeans 'designed at the brand's own factory in Marcianise, near Naples' (note: 'designed', not 'made'). Tailoring school 'since 2000' runs 'in the maison's workshops'. Arzano as the CURRENT tailoring/shirt factory is stated by Wikipedia (citing WWD/Il Sole 24 Ore), not on the Kiton pages read - Kiton's own text places Arzano only in the founding story.
craft_evidence.countries: Italy implied by named own factory on 5/9 (Fidenza, Collecchio, Marcianise); literal 'Made in' text appears on 0/9 checked; 4/9 state no place (cashmere jacket, tuxedo suit, 2 cotton shirts). Sample of 9 PDPs on us.kiton.com: jacket, tuxedo, 2 shirts, 2 knits, trousers, jeans, blouson. Shoes and ties not sampled.
